To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the hierarchical networks are more complicated than non-hierarchical ones and that our proposed probabilistic algorithms are effective in testing the networks.
we present probabilistic algorithms to detect faults in hierarchical networks and that the algorithms have a high fault coverage, are efficient and are easy to implement.
we have proposed probabilistic testing algorithms to detect faults of hierarchical networks with a high fault coverage and with a feasible number (reduced to the minimum) of tests.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of probabilistic testing algorithms for hierarchical networks with the new features.
the development of a new generation of testing algorithms for hierarchical networks.
the development of new algorithms for conformance testing and the application of the testing algorithms to hierarchical networks with the added features.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we provide probabilistic algorithms for fault detection of hierarchical network protocols that guarantee a high fault detection rate and a feasible number of test cases.

we present a novel probabilistic algorithm for hierarchical network testing and we prove that it guarantees a high fault coverage and a feasible number of test with the added features of the hierarchy.
we have proposed probabilistic algorithms for conformance testing of hierarchical networks with a guaranteed high fault coverage and a feasible number of test cases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the probabilistic algorithms provide a feasible number of test for hierarchical networks with high fault coverage and that the test equivalence classes reduce the number of test without losing the fault detection capability.
our algorithms are capable of detecting faults in a hierarchical network with added features with a high fault coverage, a small number of test cases and a short test execution time.
the probabilistic testing algorithms are very effective and that the hierarchical networks are not more complex than the non-hierarchical networks in terms of fault detection.
The main takeaway from our work is that
probabilistic algorithms for hierarchical networks with added features are feasible and efficient.
probabilistic testing algorithms are a viable solution for testing hierarchical networks.
hierarchical networks are not necessarily more complex to test than non-hierarchical networks and that the added features of the networks do not necessarily complicate testing.
